newsitem.title: USA: Shurgard files $300 mln debt, stock shelf.
newsitem.headline: Shurgard files $300 mln debt, stock shelf.

text.p: Shurgard Storage Centers Inc Thursday filed a shelf registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to $300 million in debt securities and preferred and Class A common stock.

Net proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes, which will include the development and acquisition of additional properties and other acquisition transactions, the expansion and improvement of certain properties in the portfolio and the repayment of debt, the company said.
Shurgard, based in Seattle, Wash., is a self-administered self managed REIT that develops, acquires, owns and manages self storage centers.
